versions.changelog:
- Adds detailed output formatting instructions for issue reports (`[FILE:LINE] ISSUE_TITLE`).
- Introduces mandatory “hard gate” pre-reporting steps to ensure thorough review before reporting findings.
- Requires referencing concrete artifacts or downgrading to a review question when findings depend on watchOS-specific behaviors.
- Enforces compliance with a linked review verification protocol before reporting.
- No changes to core checklist or reference sections.

- Adds detailed review checklist for key watchOS-specific patterns, including app lifecycle, complications, connectivity, and performance.
- Provides quick reference links to focused documentation for common watchOS code issues.
- Includes review questions to guide code evaluation for lifecycle, background tasks, UI updates, and WatchConnectivity best practices.
- Clarifies when to use each reference during code review.
